_note: The choice is computed on validation only and applied unchanged to the test part, which was already examined in the baseline. C(lambda) = C_miss + lambda * C_false_alarm, lambda >= 0, where lambda scales the alarm side relative to the missed-attack side; lambda = 1 reproduces the accepted per-class weights of configs/xiiotid_severity_cost.json. Those weights are relative hypotheses, not measured monetary damage. Attack-to-attack confusions stay counted and unweighted.

selector.rule: argmin of C(lambda) over the pool
selector.tie_break: lowest C_false_alarm, then variant name ascending; at a crossing the two variants cost the same and the boundary belongs to the interval that starts there, so intervals are closed on the left and open on the right
